Team —

Following today's cross-functional sync, I'm capturing the follow-ups we promised NorthernCare ahead of their QBR on Friday (attached draft deck). Two asks surfaced that need product/eng alignment:

1) Roadmap exception for prioritized latency SLA on embeddings when requests come from their VPC (they're asking for a 20ms tail SLO for 99th percentile for short embeddings). Product needs to confirm feasibility + rollout window.
2) A short note on retention and audit log exports (SOC audit coming). Security asked for an export cadence recommendation we can commit to.

Concrete asks and owners:
- Lauren: update the QBR deck with an explicit ETA and fallback plan for embeddings SLA exception; add a simple impact slide for cost/ops.
- Grace: confirm what audit/log export formats we can guarantee by end of June and an estimated engineering effort in story points.
- Marcus (me): coordinate with NorthernCare procurement on contract language for the SLA exception and draft the mutual action plan.

Please reply with status updates by EOD Tuesday so I can finalize the deck before the exec prep sync on Wednesday.

Attachments: QBR-deck-draft-v2.pdf (slide deck), roadmap-exceptions-log.csv (current exceptions table)

Thanks,
Marcus

Folks —

Quick engineering/security lens:

- Audit/log exports: We can support a daily export of the relevant routing/audit logs in JSON or CSV to an S3 bucket by June 25 with one engineer (2 weeks) to wire the export job and automated delivery. If NorthernCare needs hourly exports or streaming, that becomes a larger scoped piece (~4–6 weeks).
- Embeddings latency exception: Technically we can prioritize inference execution on a dedicated pool for NorthernCare which will likely meet the latency SLO for short sequences — estimated 3–4 weeks to stand up the pool + validation (assuming no infra constraints). That assumes we can provision capacity in us-west-2 this sprint.

Risks: If capacity is constrained we should agree the fallback policy (route to existing cluster) and a clear SLA credit formula.

I'll add these bullets to the exceptions log (roadmap-exceptions-log.csv) and flag the item for product prioritization.

Grace
Head of Product Operations
